title: Planning in the Backbone: DiffAdapterVLA for Native Continuous Trajectory Generation with Driving VLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.15322v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pretrained driving vision-language models (VLMs) integrate visual, route, language, and driving context into rich driving priors, yet their representation objectives remain separated from continuous driving planning. Existing methods typically begin trajectory generation only after the VLM has formed a final condition, leaving depth-wise condition computation outside the stepwise formation of trajectory state. We introduce DiffAdapterVLA, which realizes Planning in the Backbone: it injects explicit trajectory tokens into selected VLM late layers, bringing trajectory state into backbone forward computation, where it co-evolves with driving conditions at different depths. Lightweight layer-wise DiffAdapters organize this computation into recursive trajectory refinement, while asymmetric joint attention preserves directed guidance from the condition stream to trajectory planning. translated_title: 骨干网络中的规划：DiffAdapterVLA——基于驾驶视觉语言模型的原生连续轨迹生成
translated_abstract: 预训练的驾驶视觉语言模型（VLM）将视觉、路线、语言和驾驶上下文整合为丰富的驾驶先验，但其表示目标仍与连续驾驶规划相分离。现有方法通常仅在VLM形成最终条件之后才开始轨迹生成，使深度条件计算处于轨迹状态逐步形成的过程之外。我们提出DiffAdapterVLA，实现“骨干网络中的规划”：它将显式轨迹token注入选定的VLM后期层，使轨迹状态进入骨干网络的前向计算，与不同深度的驾驶条件共同演化。轻量级的分层DiffAdapter将这一计算组织为递归式轨迹细化，而非对称联合注意力则保持了从条件流到轨迹规划的有向引导。通过将规划过程嵌入现有的骨干网络计算……
tldr: DiffAdapterVLA通过将轨迹token注入驾驶VLM骨干网络的后期层，使轨迹规划与驾驶条件在深度前向计算中共同演化，并借助分层适配器与递归式细化实现原生连续轨迹生成。
en_tdlr: DiffAdapterVLA realizes "Planning in the Backbone" by injecting explicit trajectory tokens into late layers of the driving VLM, allowing trajectory planning to co-evolve with driving conditions during forward computation and enabling native continuous trajectory generation through lightweight layer-wise adapters with recursive refinement.
